record.title: Chi Ma–Ai Diem suspends freight clearance after infected cargo worker detected
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.scope: Cargo clearance through Chi Ma–Ai Diem
record.direction: Both directions in notice; observed endpoint Vietnam to China.
record.movement: Import/export freight; endpoint directly evidences Vietnamese export vehicles.
record.exceptions: No cargo exemptions established in closure notices; subsequent throughput remained restricted.
record.enforcement: Chinese notice relayed by customs and provincial gate management; 40 export vehicles cleared on restart.
record.relationship: Renewed spell after R6-EA-003; distinct from March closure R6-EA-005.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; unknown endpoints are not extended to 21 October 2026.
record.official_rationale: Contact tracing and control after a cargo worker tested positive.
record.context: Chi Ma was trading between December 22 reopening and this renewed shutdown.
record.uncertainty: Sources disagree on hour (08:00 versus afternoon), not day. No all-category normalization claim.

historical.duration_note: No supported continuous operational interval for the stated scope. Observed export restoration is partial relative to initial import/export restriction; no interval.
